## Checklist

- [ ] Files are inside `assets/wallpapers/<Category>/`, named in lowercase-kebab-case (`misty-forest.jpg`)
- [ ] Each file is under 20 MB and at least 1280 px on the long side
- [ ] No watermarks, no screenshots, no NSFW
- [ ] I made it, or I have the right to share it, or I listed the original author and source in `data/meta.json`
- [ ] I did not edit `data/wallpapers.json` or `assets/thumbs/` (they are generated automatically)
